title: Recording: Everybody’s In A Hurry But Me by Ringo Starr | 1982
content:
Santa Barbara Sound Recording, Santa Barbara
Producers: Joe Walsh, Russ Ballard
Engineer: Jim Nipar

Ringo Starr finished recording ‘Everybody’s In A Hurry But Me’ for his ninth studio album, Old Wave, on 6 August 1982.

The song was the result of a studio jam on 14 March 1982, featuring Eric Clapton and Joe Walsh on guitars, The Who’s John Entwistle on bass, and Ray Cooper on percussion. The jam took place at Startling Studios, in Starr’s Tittenhurst Park home.

Walsh later overdubbed extra guitar parts, and Starr’s lead vocals were added at Santa Barbara Sound Recording on this day.

Page last updated: 3 June 2026
